# NainDev Status

> Public status page with uptime, response latency and operational health of the NainDev platforms, probed automatically from GitHub Actions.

## Links

- [Status page](https://status.naindev.com/): current state of every monitored service
- [Raw metrics](https://status.naindev.com/data/status.json): latest probe results as JSON
- [Source repository](https://github.com/Nain9Dev/status): monitor script and workflow
- [NainDev](https://www.naindev.com/): main site of the author, Aitor Nain
